Young Artist Frames the Future

Student of animation and gaming turns a camera, a canvas and a keen eye into stories

Photo

S K MAHAMMAD, 2026.

VIJAYAWADA — A B.Sc. Animation and Gaming student at K L University is drawing attention for a restless creative streak spanning filmmaking, photography and 2D animation.

Fluent in four languages, he works in Blender, Maya and DaVinci Resolve, and says he is eager to learn through real projects and collaborations.

EXCLUSIVE
01 — About

Every frame is a decision.

I’m a B.Sc. Animation and Gaming student at K L University with a deep pull toward filmmaking, cinematography and visual storytelling. I work across photography, videography, graphic design and 2D animation, and I’m eager to grow through real projects and collaborations.
